source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 1 Lesson 1, pdf p.8-11
explanation_ar: في المحادثة Omar سأل Do you want to shake hands؟ وNour قالت Yes وسلّموا على بعض.
passage:
Nour: Hello!
Omar: Hello! What's your name?
Nour: My name is Nour.
Omar: Nice to meet you, Nour! Do you want to shake hands?
Nour: Yes! (They shake hands.) Goodbye, Omar!
Omar: Goodbye, Nour!
explanation_en: In the conversation Omar asked Do you want to shake hands? and Nour said Yes and they shook hands.

source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 1 Lesson 1, pdf p.8-11
explanation_ar: في أول المحادثة Nour بتقول Hello.
passage:

explanation_en: At the start of the conversation Nour says Hello.
